body:
Spatial Studio separates working Scene and Environment drafts from deliberate Library saves, immutable releases and reuse. This draft combines the contextual Inspector, expanded Library, Scene Manager, environment-aware Assistant, photo reconstruction, groups/exclusion zones, timelines and typed assets/effects. OpenAI credentials stay server-side through the shared Windows user environment; real keys, private photographs and local databases remain outside Git.

The current four-path correction fixes a context menu choosing a focusable page wrapper outside its control as the opener. That omitted the Studio scrollport from the opening snapshot, so a queued one-pixel scroll closed Save draft. Opener lookup now stays inside the context area, and the header restores focus without scrolling. Actual later scrolling still dismisses the menu. The three older direct-placement, exclusion-zone and parametric-room journeys now use current Properties/Spatial context and Engineering controls; selected-item heading semantics are restored with the same appearance.

### Current verification

- **Tested source:** `3dedbb9cd10e548d10d58bddef6d48c1823f54e5`. Uninstrumented production Chromium passes **4/4 focused** and **11/11 combined** cases, with zero failures, skipped or not-run cases. These overlapping batches are not added as distinct coverage. Production builds, full TypeScript, source-clean bindings and owned runtime cleanup pass.
- All **208 original matcher signatures, arguments and order** remain unchanged. Working membership, definition identity, natural Library entry, canonical working-draft save, geometry, cancellation, Undo/Redo and reload outcomes are preserved. There is no pre-click settlement, grace timer or click retry. The new queued-scroll regression fails before the repair; all three menu tests pass afterward.
- The first corrective run on `43171b3a6bdd` retains two passes and two Save draft failures, including the captured event sequence. All earlier failed and instrumented runs remain unchanged in the [preceding checkpoint](Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/library-entry-repair-20261017/README.md). The [current four-path record](Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/four-path-correction-20261017/README.md) contains complete native archives, exact source identities, logs, reports, media and reviews.
- A fresh same-source receipt at 390×844 measures a **370 px** canvas, **48.5 px** selection card and **zero horizontal document overflow**. Independent local rendered reviews inspect 23 focused PNGs/four complete recordings and four current Library PNGs/one complete recording, with substantive observations across all 17 dimensions and no actionable bounded finding. They do not establish trusted, whole-product, owner or physical acceptance.
- The exact SC-00C Library component/test blobs from `f7b0737acc2dccc46a87770ec7bfd02ebf28f09c` remain unchanged; its lane was not restarted. The separate SC-02 legacy test migration remains unapplied.
- Changed-source/test ESLint, documentation validation and Feature Catalog sync/validation pass (68 entries). The unchanged Library dependency warning remains documented in the earlier checkpoint. These ordinary corrections do not promote a catalog capability or mainline availability. At four-path publication, Git custody verified all **214** artifact byte hashes and exact owner blobs.
- Published head `8715b61b301df519fff637e52ecd2d982ca38271` adds evidence/documentation after the tested source. Git verifies byte-identical product/test/dependency source against `3dedbb9cd10e`; the browser receipt remains attributed to its actual tested commit.

### Remaining integration and physical boundary

R20 infrastructure PR #775 is now merged at main `40491dd68ace88ee033b53fd264ddbfe303c6d28`, tree `026ac51825b5ef5c9620fda6b50fe6f6246a6470`. This is not #721 product acceptance. The October 19 static intake found only three R20 overlaps in documentation navigation/generated indexes and no direct product conflict in that bounded slice. The approved three product contract targets remain pending #721 intake; no merge simulation, source import, workflow run, R19 reuse bridge or counter change occurred. The existing cloud #721 owner retains the fresh-capture/review/qualification/landing sequence; #722 waits for its actual accepted landed tuple.


No local blocker remains in these four named paths. The whole Studio still needs complete-candidate qualification. Protected #722 capture, qualification, accepted-base reconciliation and merge remain held until #721 qualifies, lands through protection and passes landed verification. Read-only GitHub verification still finds #721 open/draft at `b55f5a32b7a6`, with no merge in the latest read-only snapshot. The designated cloud task solely owns Crossdeck, Reach and systemic workflow execution. Root has not dispatched competing qualification, consumed/reset finite Crossdeck proof or imported unmerged dependency work. Separately gated SC-00A and Admiralty retain their coordinated queue.

The [combined verification record](Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/Root_Coexistence_20261015.md) and [cohort decision log](Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/Cohort_Integration_Decision_Log_20261016.md) retain exact owner handoffs and historical evidence without rebinding. Further ordinary protection, full affected journeys, independent rendered review and landed smoke remain required after the accepted dependency.

Real iPhone Safari calibration remains failed with unknown cause: upright steady use, frequent resets and no completed alignment/error after the second corner set. The menu diagnosis above concerns Studio Save draft, not that physical failure. Both prototype providers return no admitted planes; automatic surface/edge alignment, stable mapping and walk-around anchoring remain **UNQUALIFIED**. TinyVIO remains prototype-only; no restricted 8th Wall binary is adopted. No paid inference, private-photo processing, shared database mutation, shared phone-pilot restart, camera-engine or licensing change occurs in this correction. This remains an unmerged draft, not a ready phone-AR release.
